title: Synthetic ski facilities

paragraphs.text: Good morning, Stretton Skiing Club. How may I help you?
Oh, hello. I spoke to you last week about the registration for my son David and my nephew Kevin for next month. I would like to know more information about the courses.
Oh, yes. Uh, I'll just get some details from you. Can I have your name?
It's Carol Smith.
And your sons' and nephew's full names, please.
David Smith and Kevin Walker.
Okay, I've put that down. What would you like to know, Mrs. Smith?
I am trying to find your club on the map. My family and I are from Houston. We just arrived here a month ago, and I'm afraid we aren't very familiar with this town yet. Where are you located exactly?
Our address is twenty-three John Street, just beside a supermarket. It's at the north end of the street. Make sure you don't go in the opposite direction, as it's very busy on the other end.
Okay. Then the next thing I want to ask about is parking. We'll come by car, and I heard parking is rather difficult around that area. Do you know where we can find a spot?

If you come in the early morning, it's quite easy to find a place to park on the street. However, if you get here in the late afternoon, it's better to choose Brentwood Station, which is equipped with an underground car park. There are signs which you can easily notice, so you won't miss it.
Great. Could you tell me about your opening hours for next month? We can't find anything on your website.

Well, sure. A lot of our customers are parents who have to work, so we do offer flexible start and finish times. From January to August, the opening hours are from eight AM to six thirty PM. From September to December, we are open from seven thirty in the morning until midnight.
Let me see. I need to get to work in the city by nine AM, so I'll drop them off at eight thirty AM. Since you're pretty close to the city, it would give me plenty of time to get to work.
Yes, we are not far from any office blocks in town.
Great. By the way, I won't be able to pick them up until after lunch. Do you offer any food or drinks?

Certainly. You don't need to worry about that. There is a cafe next to the reception desk of the club, and there are various kinds of drinks available, like hot chocolate, which is the most popular choice. We also have some cold drinks, such as cola and orange squash, and there is a variety of food.
Great. Do you have pizza? That is my son's favorite.
Yes, we do, and that's only served to children. We have hamburgers and noodles for adults.
Fantastic.
Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
I've seen a lot of posters showing the activities you have on offer, and I'd like to know which ones are suitable for my son and nephew. Could you tell me more about them?
Yes, of course. First comes the snowboarding course.
Oh, my son is very good at that.

Well, unfortunately, we only have classes for beginners. No advanced courses are available. If your nephew is a beginner, he might be interested. Oh, I almost forgot. Please remember to bring waterproof clothes because he will need them during training.
Okay. I will keep that in mind if we decide to put him in the course.
How old is your nephew? We don't accept students under six years old.
He is seven already. What else is there to choose?
We also offer the beginner ski package. This is held on our outdoor slopes, and it is inaccessible when it is raining.
I see. Is there anything else we need to bring for that?
Well, we used to provide boots here, but now they're all worn out, so you have to bring your own. Also, since it involves a lot of jumping and stretching, wearing jeans is not recommended.
Yeah, I understand.
The last option is combined training, which includes ice skating and skiing. We have classes for all levels.
That sounds interesting. Maybe they could both join that course.
Yes. As the class is very popular, I'd like to recommend that you sign them up as soon as possible. Otherwise, there would be no places left.
Oh, really? I will have to discuss with the boys soon before I make sure.

Okay. By the way, we don't offer gloves, so you need to equip them well before you come in case their hands freeze after exposure to low temperature. No extra equipment is expected from you, as we have everything here.
Thanks for all the information. I'll call you back once we make the decision.
Great. We look forward to having them here.
Goodbye.
Bye.
